title: aes-128/aes-192/aes-256, 3 rounds: Mixture-integral distinguisher (10 CP) [GS20]

target.description: Three nonlinear AES rounds; the bytewise test is specified after removing the final MixColumns operation. For ordinary AES with a known final linear layer, apply its inverse to the ciphertexts first. The property does not depend on the key size or key-schedule details.

setting.key_relation: One unknown key with fixed roundkeys; this key-schedule-independent equality test also applies to the registered common-secret-Sbox AES128 variant.
setting.plaintext_model: Five related two-plaintext sets, ten nonadaptive chosen plaintexts in total.
assumptions: Theorem3 requires only a bijective commonSbox and the public AES linear layer; neither key values nor Sbox values are needed by this distinguisher.
setting.reference_model: Distinguish three-round secret-key AES from a random permutation under nonadaptive chosen-plaintext access; source experiments use 21-round AES as the random surrogate.

time.note: At most 1920 operations. Source conversion to about 2^5 three-round encryptions is explicitly approximate because lookup table sizes differ.

memory.note: No separate numerical budget is stated for this configuration.

preprocessing.note: No separate numerical budget is stated for this configuration.

success.description: About 95% source-reported distinguishing success, with 300000 trials. Six-plaintext theory and experiment differ and are not mixed with this point. This is a one-sided random-permutation rejection rate (AES acceptance is one), not equal-prior classifier accuracy. Reported approximate values are preserved, not turned into certified lower bounds.

components.description: The distinct2019 author manuscript PDF13 reports94.4% rejection over250000 tests at10chosen plaintexts, using21-round AES as its random-permutation surrogate. This is a source-reported one-sided distinguishing experiment, not full-key recovery or equal-prior classifier accuracy. The exact raw outcome numerator is unavailable; do not infer one from the rounded percentage, pool it with proceedings300000 trials, or replace that edition's approximately95% main value.

limitations: Overlapping four-text sets are dependent. Independent equality-partition counting under the random-function approximation gives rejection probabilities 0.610451780826825,0.8286863776900614,0.9417333194091994,0.984704970673595 for6,8,10,12 plaintexts; these are reviewer calculations, not replacement author-reported data.

field_conflicts.description: Keep the author-reported approximately95% point, but the claims of probability higher than95% at ten plaintexts are not justified by the dependent-set construction.
